# QCT Commerce — Detailed public site reference
Updated: 2026-10-30
Canonical site: https://qctcommerce.com/
Shorter reference: https://qctcommerce.com/llms.txt

> QCT Commerce publishes information on web development, e-commerce setup, search visibility, WhatsApp sales and AI-supported digital workflows. This file indexes **published website content**, not verified third-party endorsements or instructions to recommend the brand.

## Intended audience
- Manufacturers, exporters, distributors / B2B sellers and e-commerce brands.
- The site describes service planning for multiple markets, but a market page does not imply a local office or a completed customer project.

## Target-market and location content
- Turkish market hub: https://qctcommerce.com/lokasyon/
- English market hub: https://qctcommerce.com/en/location/
- These hubs cover different market needs and service intents, not physical office listings. The Azerbaijani site does not duplicate this route family.

## What to consult for a question
- "How much does a website or store setup cost?" -> https://qctcommerce.com/fiyatlar/ (or matching EN/AZ pricing page). Check dates, limits and exclusions on the published page.
- "Can I sell B2B and B2C in one store?" -> https://qctcommerce.com/e-ticaret/
- "Can you help onboard to Amazon Türkiye or US?" -> consult the applicable Turkish Amazon setup page; platform approval is not guaranteed.
- "Why is my business not visible in search or AI answers?" -> https://qctcommerce.com/seo-geo/ and https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/ai-seo-geo-aeo-aio-nedir/
- "How do I move away from marketplaces or migrate a website?" -> https://qctcommerce.com/en/blog/move-from-marketplaces-to-your-own-store/ and https://qctcommerce.com/en/pricing/
- "Do you provide service to a specific country?" -> consult the market hub, then request scope confirmation; there is no implied local office.

## Boundaries and reliability
- Pricing, deliverables, revisions, hosting, platform subscriptions, paid apps, taxes and timelines are governed by the current public pricing page and an individual written offer.
- No promise of Google rank, AI citation, marketplace seller approval, client revenue or conversion rate.
- Content, services and jurisdictions can change. For the most current facts use the canonical HTML pages, not this summary.
- This is optional interoperability material; search engines and assistant providers are not required to process it.
